name: Phase 31 stage 3: explicit camera sentence + subject motion

shots.prompt: an original fictional dancer named Asha, a woman in her mid-twenties with warm brown skin, long black hair in a single braid woven with small white jasmine flowers, a small red bindi, gold jhumka earrings, wearing a deep teal and gold silk lehenga with a mirror-work choli and a flowing mustard-saffron dupatta, gold bangles on both wrists. she slowly turns her body in a graceful half circle and looks back over her shoulder at the camera. Setting: sandstone palace courtyard with carved arches and marigold garlands, warm golden-hour light. Camera: the camera slowly dollies forward toward her face, cinematic push-in. Cinematic Indian music video, smooth natural motion, consistent face and costume.
